eligibility.basis: Judged real sessions: judge-l2 (10 Oct 2026, 122 findings), judge-l4 (12 Oct 2026, 87 findings) and the first shadow run (12 Oct 2026, 64 sessions, 12 pieces of advice). fragmented_edits: 17 of 17 waste in judge-l2 and judge-l4; in shadow 5 waste, 0 not waste, 1 unsure (edits interleaved with publishes that may have checked a result). repeated_exploration: 10 of 10 waste in judge-l4; its 3 shadow rows were not waste, all re-read images that a render or script had redrawn in between. An image read returns no text to compare, so such re-reads are now uncertain and never advised; identical text still shows the file did not change. regeneration is no longer eligible: shadow judged 0 waste, 2 not waste (files under 1 KB, where a rewrite costs no more than an edit) and 1 unsure, against judge-l4's 3 of 3 from one session. edit-not-rewrite stays in the file so shadow mode records what it would have said, as ineligible.

advice.message: Claude is editing the same file in many small round trips. Asking it to plan the change and make it in one edit (or parallel edits) saves the extra turns.
Claude re-read a file, or re-ran a search, with no edit in between. The answer is already in its context; a note in CLAUDE.md to reuse earlier reads and search results avoids the repeat.
Claude rewrote a whole file that mostly repeats what was there. An in-place edit produces only the change and keeps the diff reviewable.
